vulnerability_title: [H-03] Balancer oracle uses vault balances as price and can be steered by anyone

recommendation.recommendation_text: Do not use raw Vault balances as an oracle for slippage protection of large protocol swaps.

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: getPrice divides the Balancer Vault pool balances, which is a spot price anyone can move by trading. updatePrice is public and folds that spot price into the stored average, and validatePrice only checks the spot price against that average.
patterns_found: spot reserve ratio used as oracle price
permissionless update of the stored price average
slippage check against a manipulable average

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: spot pool balance ratio used as oracle price
